intro.title: Two ways to put groundwater in your hands.
intro.lede: An app for recording what a village actually observes, and a game for understanding what those observations mean together.

items.name: MyWell
items.description: Bhujal Jankaars and community members record groundwater levels, rainfall, water quality and check-dam readings against a station, then browse the shared map and watch the trends build up over seasons.

items.name: MARVI Groundwater Game
items.description: A whole village draws from one shared well. Choose crops, take watering turns and watch the watertable answer back — the fastest way to feel why groundwater cannot be managed one farm at a time.
